import numpy as np
def equation(t, x, v, params):
    p=params
    g=t**0.65
    return (p[0] + p[1]*x + p[2]*x**2 + p[3]*np.sin(x) + p[4]/x + p[5]*v + p[6]*v*v
            + g*(p[7] + p[8]*x + p[9]*np.exp(-x)))
